what_it_probes: A ~10k-line threaded job queue with five symptom-only support tickets (the lead one blames retry backoff) whose real causes are fourteen independent bugs across modules: ack/nack and cancel validated before a lock release and committed after it, heartbeat renewing a lease it does not own, idempotency normalisation folding distinct keys, WAL replay in file order, an untruncated torn tail, lock-free metrics, lazy delay promotion stamping promotion time, Julian leap years in cron, uncapped decorrelated jitter, a checkpoint position read after the state capture, prefetched jobs dropped on pool shutdown, an off-by-one on expiry at the last attempt, and a result cache key that omits the tenant; plus a second stage implementing an exactly specified weighted-round-robin fair queue and a WAL anomaly report (`taskmill doctor`) with byte-exact output, all without serialising handlers, WAL I/O, checkpoints or hooks behind the broker lock.
